answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system with a proof-of-stake (PoS) mechanism to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent stakes a unique digital asset on a virtual "terrace" of validators, which acts as a "prism" to refract and evaluate honest behavior. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to stake a proportionally large amount of assets, making it costly. This deters malicious activity, as illustrated in the ancient "fable" of costly signaling, where only honest validators can afford the stake, thereby securing the network.
